body.value: 藩制一覽表第九（清末）
藩制一覧表 第九冊（清末）— 版面右端の柱書（はんせいいちらんひょう だいきゅうさつ・きよすえ）

Running header in the outer right margin: Domain Survey Table, ninth fascicle (Kiyosue). The nine 藩制一覽表 fascicles are numbered registers of the 1869-70 Dajōkan survey, not thematic volumes; fascicles eight and nine carry officials and military strength. The header names Kiyosue because Kiyosue's entry opens on this leaf at the ○清末藩 marker. It is provenance, not domain data, and it does not govern the troop figures printed to its left but to the right of that marker — those are the preceding domain's, Kitsuki.
柱藩制一覽表第九清末
四百四十
四百四十（440）

Printed folio number 440 in the outer margin, set 四 / 百 / 四 / 十 stacked. The final glyph is 十, a plain cross with no slanted stroke riding on top, so it is not 千. The facing leaf (lower_p232_left) prints 四百四十一 (441), confirming that this recto is 440 and that reading runs from this half-leaf to that one. Page furniture belonging to the leaf, not to either domain printed on it.
丁付四百四十
兵隊
兵隊（へいたい）

Heading of the military block: Troops. It stands alone with no numeral of its own; the five columns to its left carry the components and the grand total. Belongs to the preceding domain, Kitsuki, whose entry is closing on this leaf — in fascicles eight and nine a domain's troop return prints after its officials and runs on past the next domain's maru-marker.
杵築兵隊
士族兵隊　三小隊　各隊四十人
士族兵隊（しぞくへいたい）三小隊、各隊四十人

Shizoku (former samurai) infantry: three platoons, forty men to a platoon — 120 men. The rate 各隊四十人 is set in half-size annotation type at the foot of the column (glyph heights 40-45 px against 58-61 px for the main type). The numeral is 三, printed as three separate horizontal strokes, not 五. Kitsuki's, not Kiyosue's: the column stands right of the ○清末藩 marker.
杵築士族兵隊
卒族隊　五小隊　同斷
卒族隊（そつぞくたい）五小隊、同断（どうだん＝右に同じ、一隊四十人）

Sotsu (lower retainer) troops: five platoons. 同斷 is the ditto note in half-size type, carrying over the forty-men-per-platoon rate stated for the shizoku platoons immediately to the right, so five platoons at forty is 200 men. Kitsuki's.
杵築卒族隊
大炮隊　四十人
大炮隊（たいほうたい）四十人

Artillery company: 40 men. The numeral is three glyphs only — 四 / 十 / 人 — set on the same even pitch as the rest of the column, so there is no unit between 十 and 人 and the figure cannot be 46. Kitsuki's.
杵築大炮隊
外ニ役員六十人
外に役員（やくいん）六十人

In addition, 60 officers and staff. The ニ is the half-size katakana particle set between 外 and 役員. This column starts lower down the leaf than the three to its right, which is how the fascicle marks it as an addendum to the platoon counts rather than another platoon type. Kitsuki's.
杵築外ニ役員
惣計四百二十六人
惣計（そうけい）四百二十六人

Grand total of the domain's armed strength: 426 men. The components printed to the right do not reach it — 120 shizoku plus 200 sotsu plus 40 artillery plus 60 officers is 420, six short. Every component was re-checked at single-character scale and each holds, so the six-man gap is the print's own inconsistency rather than a transcription slip; the project's MASTER dataset also carries 426. Kitsuki's.
杵築惣計
○清末藩
○清末藩（きよすえはん）

Maru-marker opening the entry for Kiyosue Domain, a 10,000-koku sub-branch of Chōfu in Nagato province. It is the only marker on the leaf and it is the boundary that governs everything else here: the six military columns to its right close out Kitsuki's return, while every column to its left — three ranks of officials, eight named appointees and the opening of the troop return — is Kiyosue's.
清末藩マル標
大參事　一人
大参事（だいさんじ）一人

Senior Councillor: 1 man. The numeral sits on the same vertical axis as the heading and the column beneath holds a single name, Naitō Chūtarō, with the lower name-register empty — which is how this fascicle shows a rank whose roster is exhausted after one appointee.
清末大參事
權大參事　一人　二人
権大参事（ごんだいさんじ）一人〔小書「二人」〕

Provisional Senior Councillor. Two numerals belong to this heading. The main-type 一人 sits on the heading's own axis. The 二人 to its right is set in half-size annotation type — its 人 measures 45 px high and the pair 52 px wide, against 60 px and 65 px for the main-type numerals — and it stands 4 px from this column's numeral but 19 px from the 大參事 numeral, hugging the right edge of this column in the gutter, which is where this fascicle puts a compiler's gloss (a half-size マヽ sits the same way on lower_p216_right, beside a 少參事 三人). The roster decides the reading: two names stand in this column, Iki Yosazaemon over Hiroi Shōkichi, and one plus two plus five is exactly the eight names printed on the leaf. The same correction pattern recurs on lower_p231_right, where 權少參事 prints 一人 with a half-size 二人 above a column of two names. So the printed 一人 understates its own roster by one and the small 二人 supplies the corrected figure, which is what is parsed here.
清末權大參事
少參事　五人
少参事（しょうさんじ）五人

Junior Councillor: 5 men. The figure is 五, not 三: the glyph is one connected block with the crossed centre and closing base stroke rather than three separate strokes. Five names follow in the three columns running leftward from this heading — Hirai Ihachirō over Takano Takumaro, Katami Kojirō over Sakamoto Kenzō, and Emoto Kurōkichi alone — filling the ranks two to a column as this fascicle does.
清末少參事
內藤忠太郎
內藤忠太郎（ないとう ちゅうたろう）

The single appointee standing under 大參事: Naitō Chūtarō, Senior Councillor of Kiyosue. The surname prints in the kyūjitai form 內, with 入 inside the enclosure rather than the shinjitai 内. The lower name-register of this column is empty — no ink anywhere in x1115-1210 across y2600-4150 — which is what fixes this rank at one man. Reading of the given name is tentative.
内藤忠太郎
伊木與三左衞門／廣井少吉
伊木與三左衛門（いき よさざえもん）／廣井少吉（ひろい しょうきち）

The two appointees standing under 權大參事: Iki Yosazaemon in the upper register over Hiroi Shōkichi in the lower, both Provisional Senior Councillors of Kiyosue. This is the column that carries the rank's whole roster, and its two names are why the half-size 二人 beside the heading, rather than the main-type 一人, gives the working figure. Readings are tentative.
伊木與三左衞門廣井少吉
平井鑄八郎／高野琢麿
平井鑄八郎（ひらい いはちろう）／高野琢麿（たかの たくまろ）

First name column under 少參事: Hirai Ihachirō in the upper register over Takano Takumaro in the lower, Junior Councillors of Kiyosue. The fourth glyph of the upper name is 八, its two strokes clearly separate at the top and splaying outward, not 入 or 人. Readings are tentative.
平井鑄八郎高野琢麿
片見小次郎／阪本謙藏
片見小次郎（かたみ こじろう）／阪本謙藏（さかもと けんぞう）

Second name column under 少參事: Katami Kojirō in the upper register over Sakamoto Kenzō in the lower, Junior Councillors of Kiyosue. The lower surname is 阪 (mound radical), not 坂. Readings are tentative.
片見小次郎阪本謙藏
江本九郎吉
江本九郎吉（えもと くろきち）

Third and last name column under 少參事: Emoto Kurōkichi, the fifth Junior Councillor, standing alone with the lower register empty. The third glyph is 九 (the horizontal stroke turns down and hooks left at the base), not 七. Reading is tentative.
江本九郎吉
步兵四小隊　但一小隊四十人／外ニ役司二十人
歩兵（ほへい）四小隊。但し一小隊四十人、外に役司（やくし）二十人

Kiyosue's own troop return opens here, in the leaf's last column: four infantry platoons, with a 但 note set as a two-column warichu — right half 一小隊四十人 (forty men to a platoon), left half 外ニ役司二十人 (and twenty staff besides). Four platoons at forty is 160 infantry, plus the 20 staff. The fourth glyph of the left half is 司, read at 12x with its enclosing hook stroke and inner 口, not 員. The return continues on the facing leaf, folio 441, which opens with the parallel 砲隊二分隊 但一分隊十人 外ニ役司二人 — two artillery sections of ten men each and two more staff — so the same warichu pattern confirms the reading here.
清末步兵四小隊
